angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 545,447 km at 40.02 pc = 0.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 24.9867 +/- 0.0351 mas (same row, RUWE 1.16): 40.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.784 (0.767 to 0.801) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 545,447 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.745 (0.705 to 0.788) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4650 +/- 5.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4062446910648807168: teff_gspphot 4650.3584 K (16th-84th percentiles 4642.8613-4653.321), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4062446910648807168: teff_gspphot 4650.3584 K (16th-84th percentiles 4642.8613-4653.321), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/pincoya.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.522, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): spectral type K3.5 V, from Xiao et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260210919X/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 164604: main object type **, Double or Multiple Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.12 dex, from Xiao et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260210919X/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.58503, from Xiao et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260210919X/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): age 1.6 Gyr, from Xiao et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260210919X/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): rotation period 19 d, from Xiao et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260210919X/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 164604 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Nordstrom et al. 2004 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2004A&A...418..989N/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.784 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.958. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
